title: Finite reduction inverts the completion unit
statement: Let S be a small site, A a commutative ring, and d a CompleteCoefficientDatum on A [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum]. Let C, eta, F_n, p_n and e_n be the normalized completion, its unit, finite scalar extension, limit projection and finite evaluation [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. For every N in D(S,A) and every n ≥ 0, F_n(eta_N) is an isomorphism. Moreover eta_N followed by p_n and e_n is the finite scalar-extension unit.

source.place: Tag 099M; algebraization.tex Tags 091N, 0999, 099B for the derived completion reflector

proof.text: A sequential colimit with nilpotent repeated transition is zero: each colimit insertion factors through a zero composite. Apply this to multiplication by a nilpotent section to show its section localization is zero. Derived internal Hom out of it vanishes.

source.place: Tag 099M; algebraization.tex Tags 091N, 0999, 099B for the derived completion reflector

proof.text: For any quotient-coefficient object M, each element a of I has image with (n+1)st power zero. The restriction-of-scalars section completeness criterion and the constant-element criterion therefore show that Res M is derived I-complete. This works for I=0, I=A and the zero ring.

source.place: Tag 099M; algebraization.tex Tags 091N, 0999, 099B for the derived completion reflector

proof.text: The unit-preserving Koszul/quotient reflector gives a bijection Hom(CN,Res M) → Hom(N,Res M) by precomposition with eta_N. Transport it through the finite scalar adjunction. It is precomposition by F_n(eta_N) on Hom into every M, so the coyoneda criterion proves invertibility.

proof.text: Use the separately proved normalized projection/unit identity for the second assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem completionFiniteReduction (S : Site.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CompleteCoefficientDatum A)
    (N : S.derived A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((S.finiteReduction A d.ideal n).map ((S.unit A d.ideal).app N)) ∧
      (S.unit A d.ideal).app N ≫
          (show S.delta A ⋙ S.evaluate A n ≅ 𝟭 (S.derived A) from
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
              (NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ ↦ Iso.refl _) (fun _ ↦ by rfl)) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso (S.modules A)).inv.app
              ((S.completion A d.ideal).obj N) ≫
          (S.evaluate A n).map ((S.deltaAdjunction A).counit.app
            ((S.reduction A d.ideal).obj N)) ≫
          (S.finiteEvaluationIso A d.ideal n).hom.app N =
        (S.finiteAdjunction A d.ideal n).unit.app N
